scripts.infra:up: docker compose --project-directory infrastructure --env-file infrastructure/.env -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --project-directory infrastructure --env-file infrastructure/.env -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose --project-directory infrastructure --env-file infrastructure/.env -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml logs -f
scripts.infra:config: docker compose --project-directory infrastructure --env-file infrastructure/.env -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml config
